mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates compress discount rates and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: The rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 (i.e., not sufficiently negative) or not statistically significant (p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, economic uncertainty increases, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% over the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) is below 220, the stable monetary environment supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL < 220 over the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), economic uncertainty increases, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% over the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) are associated with stronger economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 95, the economy is expanding strongly, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 95 over the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 500 thousand units and residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 350,000 million dollars, the strong housing market signals robust economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 350000 over the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 90), economic weakness increases, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 90 over the most recent 3 years.
